https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io/forks still calls it canonical we don't even have the nimbus branch in our fork choice, none of the node has it, so at least not a fork choice bug, but we are completely unaware that this chain exists so lodestar nodes just build on their own branch that is an issue. feature or bug is debatable/contextual there there situations where by social agreement one wants to constraint this, to guide the chain intentionally. but this is kind of how checkpoint sync works, there's not intrinsically any history associated with it the problem is you don't have a state before, so there is no way to process blocks from a comepting branch it's a feature, it's like finalized (aka checkpoint sync), only that it is not and needs social coordination so it only really makes sense, I think, to consider it an assertion of ... well, don't have to call it finalized. but not expecting certain reorgs yeah exactly feature in a sense that I can force the node on a specific branch I view checkpoint sync as telling the client, don't reorg from this, this is effectively the base of the chain
